"""Post-inspection protocol checks, separate from the original frozen six."""
import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from test_acceptance import app_client as app_client

@pytest.mark.parametrize('path',['/health','/missing_1','/abc'])
def test_head_content_length_matches_get_or_is_omitted(app_client: TestClient,path: str):
    get=app_client.get(path,follow_redirects=False)
    head=app_client.head(path,follow_redirects=False)
    assert head.status_code==get.status_code
    assert head.content==b''
    size=head.headers.get('content-length')
    assert size is None or int(size)==len(get.content)

@pytest.mark.parametrize('target',['https://example.com/a|b?q={x}','https://example.com/a^b'])
def test_head_and_get_use_identical_redirect_encoding(app_client: TestClient,target: str):
    created=app_client.post('/links',json={'target_url':target,'code':'encode_1'})
    assert created.status_code==201
    head=app_client.head('/encode_1',follow_redirects=False)
    get=app_client.get('/encode_1',follow_redirects=False)
    assert head.status_code==get.status_code==307
    assert head.headers['location']==get.headers['location']
